gamerule.nofreeze.water_cannot_freeze.de: Water never freezes into ice: not from cold weather, not during world generation, and not under Frost Walker boots.
nofreeze.screen.title: No Freeze Settings
nofreeze.screen.note.restart: Permanent Mode changes apply the next time you open a world.
nofreeze.screen.note.server: A dedicated server uses its own config/nofreeze.json.
nofreeze.option.permanent.tooltip: On: water can never freeze, in every world, and the Water Cannot Freeze game rule is removed from /gamerule and the game rule screens. Off: the game rule is back and you choose per world. A world forgets its saved value for the rule while this is on.
nofreeze.option.block_frost_walker.toolt: While water cannot freeze, Frost Walker boots cannot turn water into frosted ice either. Turn this off to let them work.
